test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the Venn Diagram given below and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87aa7f15a3fe5ab782a87c8e8a034be4ee9987b627d709e501b3cd8ce20fa731.png] 

How many cricketers are neither boxers nor footballers?
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d97e5bba7067106f75e0f568b906a2a7ebc7d0d8b22328c628852b551bac7b98.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of cricketers are neither boxers nor footballers".

So, the total number of '**cricketers are neither boxers nor footballers**' = **3 + 12 = 15**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
